positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Lead, Caliper performance analysis tool, HP Cupertino
•	Designed and led the implementation of multiple new, major features, scalability efforts to address the needs of enterprise ISVs, support for new and upcoming Itanium processors.
•	Primary liaison with the HP-UX kernel performance team.
•	Primary liaison with the HP Virtual Machine team.
•	Resident Performance Monitoring Unit (PMU) expert in the team (e.g., for the Linux port) and in the Java, Compiler and Tools lab.
•	Contributed to the design of upcoming Itanium architecture capabilities in collaboration with Intel and HP processor, kernel and tools engineers.
•	Member of the Caliper/DCPI engineering taskforce.
•	Member of various technical and business taskforces.
•	Visited Bangalore team for face-to-face technical interactions.
